guard: deprovisionAgent truthfully distinguishes live consumer deletions from idempotent absent no-ops
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core exec tsx smoke/deprovision-agent-auth.smoke.ts
why: deleteConsumerIdempotent must classify a 404 not-found consumer as absent rather than deleted.
Mutating the 404 handler to return 'deleted' claims duplicate deletions on repeat deprovision.
The suite must catch this on the named cell asserting repeated deprovision reports 0 deleted consumers.

mutations.name: claim 404 not-found consumer as deleted on repeat deprovision
mutations.find:
if ((e as { code?: number }).code !== 404 && !/(consumer|stream) not found/i.test((e as Error).message)) throw e;
    return "absent";
mutations.replace:
if ((e as { code?: number }).code !== 404 && !/(consumer|stream) not found/i.test((e as Error).message)) throw e;
    return "deleted";
mutations.expectRed: ACCOUNTING: repeated deprovision reports 0 deleted consumers and 2 absent consumers
mutations.cell: ACCOUNTING: repeated deprovision reports 0 deleted consumers and 2 absent consumers
